f3_program: collection("talia.day_drive.distances", "distance", "talia.day_drive", source("The park they're playing at is 5 miles from Talia's house. After their game, Talia is planning to go to the grocery store 3 miles away from the park and 8 miles from her home. Starting and ending at Talia's house"))
observe(at("talia.day_drive.house_to_park.distance", "current"), 5, "mile", source("The park they're playing at is 5 miles from Talia's house"))
observe(at("talia.day_drive.park_to_grocery_store.distance", "current"), 3, "mile", source("the grocery store 3 miles away from the park"))
observe(at("talia.day_drive.grocery_store_to_home.distance", "current"), 8, "mile", source("8 miles from her home"))
same("talia.home", "talia.house", source("her home. Starting and ending at Talia's house"))
member("talia.day_drive.distances", "talia.day_drive.house_to_park.distance", source("The park they're playing at is 5 miles from Talia's house"))
member("talia.day_drive.distances", "talia.day_drive.park_to_grocery_store.distance", source("After their game, Talia is planning to go to the grocery store 3 miles away from the park"))
member("talia.day_drive.distances", "talia.day_drive.grocery_store_to_home.distance", source("8 miles from her home. Starting and ending at Talia's house"))
query("sum", "talia.day_drive.distances", "current")
assumptions: The stated itinerary is Talia's house to the park, then the grocery store, then home; “her home” corefers to Talia's house.

f3_program: collection("jim.model_cars", "model_car", "jim", source("Jim collects model cars"))
observe(at("jim.model_cars.count", "current"), 301, "count", source("he has 301 models total"))
multiple(at("jim.model_cars.buick.count", "current"), at("jim.model_cars.ford.count", "current"), 4, source("Jim has 4 times as many Buicks as Fords"))
query("value", at("jim.model_cars.buick.count", "current"))
assumptions: The clause “3 more than twice the number of Fords than Chevys” does not uniquely identify the subject and reference of the comparison, so no Ford–Chevrolet relation or exhaustive brand partition is imposed.

f3_program: observe(at("company.net_cash_from_operating_activities", "2018"), -3908, "thousand_currency", cell("Operating activities", "2018"))
observe(at("company.net_cash_from_operating_activities", "2019"), -618, "thousand_currency", cell("Operating activities", "2019"))
query("absolute_difference", at("company.net_cash_from_operating_activities", "2018"), at("company.net_cash_from_operating_activities", "2019"))
assumptions: Accounting parentheses are represented as negative cash-flow values, and the undirected word “difference” is represented as an absolute difference.

f3_program: collection("domino_game.players", "person", "domino_game", source("Jean and her three friends are playing a game of dominoes"))
member("domino_game.players", "jean", source("Jean and her three friends are playing a game of dominoes"))
collection("jean.friends", "person", "domino_game", source("her three friends are playing a game of dominoes"))
observe(at("jean.friends.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("three friends"))
offset(at("domino_game.players.count", "current"), at("jean.friends.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("Jean and her three friends"))
collection("domino_set.dominoes", "domino", "domino_set", source("There are 28 dominoes in the set"))
observe(at("domino_set.dominoes.count", "initial"), 28, "count", source("There are 28 dominoes in the set"))

quotient_relation("domino_game.dominoes_per_player.count", at("domino_set.dominoes.count", "initial"), at("domino_game.players.count", "current"), source("Jean wants each player to receive the same number of dominoes"))
query("value", "domino_game.dominoes_per_player.count")
assumptions: The singular named participant Jean contributes one player in addition to the three friends, and the full domino set is intended to be distributed among them.

f3_program: observe(at("company.purchase_obligations.more_than_5_years", "2019-06-30"), 36675, "thousand_currency", cell("Purchase obligations", "More Than 5 Years"))
observe(at("company.purchase_obligations.total", "2019-06-30"), 424561, "thousand_currency", cell("Purchase obligations", "Total"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("company.purchase_obligations.more_than_5_years", "2019-06-30"), at("company.purchase_obligations.total", "2019-06-30"))
assumptions: Both purchase-obligation amounts use the table's common thousands scale, and “total purchase obligations” refers to the Total column of the same row.
